results.content:
## Inflation Expectations Edge Higher, Undermining Confidence

The August survey showed year-ahead inflation expectations rising to 4.3% from 4.2% in July, while long-run inflation expectations remained stable at 3.3%. This uptick in near-term inflation concerns adds pressure on consumer confidence, as only 8% of respondents now expect their income growth to outpace inflation over the next year — a sharp decline from 18% in December 2024.
